text:
Ethan: hi all, im Ethan, joining as AE next week. two quick setup asks: HubSpot + Gong, Dialpad softphone, and access to the AE playbook + 1-pager collateral pack. who do i ping for each? also any tips for first week shadowing?
Onboarding Bot: welcome @Ethan! :tada: A provisioning ticket was auto-created: https://redwood.in/onboard/Ethan. You'll be added to #sales-onboarding and receive a checklist email.
Tina (sales-ops): hey @Ethan — i'll own HubSpot & Gong. fill the provisioning link and mark "sales seat". Turnaround usually same day if requested before noon, otherwise next biz day. For Gong, include your preferred email alias.
Ethan: done the form. email alias is ethan@redwood.com
Tina (sales-ops): got it. HubSpot seat queued, Gong invite in progress. For Dialpad, confirm if you want the softphone or a forwarded demo number. Softphone = app on laptop/mobile.
Ethan: softphone please. also need demo number set to "Redwood - Ethan"
Raj (IT): Softphone noted. I'll push Dialpad app via MDM once your device is enrolled. Which device do you want for demos? company-m1-mac or ubuntu-laptop?
Ethan: mac would be great.
Raj (IT): cool — scheduling the mac image build. After image is ready, run VPN + MDM enroll: 
```
bash -c "curl -fsSL https://dl.redwood/setup.sh | sudo bash"
```
Expect the build email in ~3-5 hours.
Priya (AE-buddy): hey @Ethan! i have a curated "week 0" playlist: playbook, call scripts, objection cheat sheet, and 3 recorded demos. i'll DM the Drive folder and add you to the shared Loom library. If you want to shadow, i'm free Tue/Wed 10-11am.
Ethan: thanks @Priya — ill take Tuesday 10.
Zoe (marketing): hi @Ethan — i'll drop the latest 1-pager collateral and product one-pager in the shared folder. also adding you to the customer stories deck. If you need customized slides for demos, ping me with the company logo and i'll assemble.
Tina (sales-ops): one more ops note: please complete the sales training module "Demo checklist" in Learning (link in onboarding email) before your first shadow. It covers recording consent + call note conventions.
Ethan: noted — i'll finish that tonight. thanks everyone! pumped to start. :rocket:
